payload.location:
9.7 nm off Pulau Cula, 9.4 nm off Pulau Iyu Kecil,
Indonesia Indonesia
payload.summary:
Two incidents of armed robbery against ships1 in Asia (one CAT 32 and one CAT 43) were reported to the ReCAAP ISC. Both incidents occurred
onboard bulk carriers while underway in the eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS) in Singapore Strait (SS) on 2 Nov and 4
Nov 2026. Some engine spares were stolen and one crew member sustained a minor hand injury in the CAT 3 incident. Nothing was stolen
and the crew were not injured in the CAT 4 incident. Details of the incidents are shown in table (*).
Straits of Malacca and Singapore (SOMS)
